body_paragraphs: Following up from a few days ago: Predictify Horse Racing is built for people who want numbers they can verify — not tipster noise.
The habit that works is simple: open one race on today's card, read the confidence band and form breakdown, make one call, move on.
Today's meetings are up. Pick one race before the off.
P.S. Tipsters are loud. Form tables are honest.
